applies_to: Joint-background BIC; fixed and block policies retain their current search.
rationale: Forward BIC improves both mean error metrics in all four conditions at 100, 250, 500, and 1000 mutations. Higher burdens show condition-specific regressions.

validation_gate.requirement: Both metrics decrease at each low burden; the paired 95% interval upper bound is below zero for each burden. Report each condition and cancer.
validation_gate.high_burden_requirement: All weights match the existing search exactly above 1000 mutations.
validation_gate.sensitivity: Repeat at 50 and 100 mutations without the ten-mutation generating-truth cutoff.
validation_gate.no_retuning: Keep this policy fixed during validation; retain any failing result.

limitations: The policy threshold follows synthetic tuning, not a biological boundary.
Fresh draws share empirical exposure distributions; no patient-level generalization claim.
